<!--
Thanks for getting in touch. SPEAKERS.md has the full picture.

Fill in only what applies. You never have to explain why you are asking for
something, and if you want your talk removed the first two lines are enough —
delete the rest.
-->

**Which talk:**
<!-- The title is plenty. It does not need to be a talk that already has a
     transcript here — most sessions have none, and slides alone make a real
     entry. -->

**Are you the speaker?**
<!-- Yes / No — if no, say who you are. Removals are actioned for the speaker
     or an organiser. -->

---

### Sharing material

Anything here is welcome, and all of it is optional.

- [ ] **Slides** — link, or attach the PDF to this issue
- [ ] **References** — papers, repos, specs, posts cited in the talk
- [ ] **A recording** of your own (better than the fourth row, and it would
      replace the attendee transcript rather than sit beside it)
- [ ] **A transcript** you already have, e.g. from your own captioning
- [ ] **Something you wrote up afterwards** — post, thread, docs, follow-up talk

**Links:**
<!-- Paste them here, in any order, no formatting needed. -->

**How would you like to be credited?**
<!-- Defaults to your name as it appears in the conference programme. -->

---

### Asking for a change

- [ ] **Correct something** — a name, a term, a company, the background note
- [ ] **Remove it** — the transcript, the summary, the bio note, or the whole
      entry. No reason needed, and you will not be asked for one.

**Details:**
<!-- Correction: what it says now, and what it should say.
     Removal: nothing further needed. -->
